title: AI chatbot ad platform Gravity raises $30.5M Series A funding
excerpt: Gravity places ads in AI platforms, including ChatGPT, Codebuff, Magneta, and Runnable. It has begun exploring agent-to-agent ads.
content_html:
Exclusive

A startup that places ads for brands like Best Buy and Target in AI platforms raised $30.5 million

By Lara O'Reilly

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the CMO Insider newsletter

Zach Oldham, cofounder of the adtech startup Gravity, thinks AI ads will eventually become the world's largest advertising channel.

His company just secured fresh funds to pursue the opportunity he sees in both ads designed to appeal to humans on AI platforms and those targeted at AI bots themselves.

Gravity exclusively told CMO Insider it raised a $30.5 million Series A funding round, co-led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Committed Capital. It brings the startup's total funding to $38.5 million.

Gravity offers a full-stack ad platform: a demand-side platform that helps advertisers place ads within AI chatbots and to agents, a supply-side platform that helps developers of AI applications monetize through ads, and an exchange that connects the two. It also offers tools to help advertisers measure campaign performance and create ads themselves.

The startup places text-based ads within AI chatbots and assistants, including ChatGPT, Codebuff, EcoGPT, Daimon, Magneta, Runable, and CTO.new. Its advertiser clients have included Best Buy, Target, Vercel, and MongoDB.

Gravity is also testing an "agent-to-agent" ad product that human users don't see. Advertisers provide Gravity with their product catalog, including up-to-date features and current promotions.

"Every time the agent is looking for shoes, it's given a list of all the different advertisers we have that are selling shoes," Oldham said. "It's got detailed descriptions and information about them, and it helps enrich the buying decision that way."

Down the road, Gravity plans to integrate direct payment solutions so an agent can make a purchase once the user gives the go-ahead.

Oldham said he hopes that increasing the prevalence of ads within large language models will encourage more AI platforms to make their services free.

Ad giant WPP Media recently estimated that marketers will spend $100 billion on ads within generative AI search globally by 2030. In April, The Information reported that OpenAI forecast that its ad business alone would hit the $100 billion milestone by 2030.

"I think that even OpenAI is off on their projections," Oldham said.

"It is much larger than they realize," he added, referring to the potential size of the AI ad market.

Gravity is a small player in a big market. Google runs the world's biggest advertising business. OpenAI has already signed up multiple adtech partners, including Adobe, StackAdapt, and Criteo. Plenty of other large adtech players are also hoping to edge in on the nascent space.

Oldham said Gravity's competitive advantage is its focus on the AI-native ad space and that it works with both buyers and sellers of this nascent ad type.

"Because we're owning the full stack, we benefit from true network effects as we scale," Oldham said. "Our network gets smarter every day that goes by."

广告技术初创公司 Gravity 的联合创始人扎克·奥尔德姆 (Zach Oldham) 认为，人工智能广告最终将成为世界上最大的广告渠道。

他的公司刚刚获得了新的资金，以寻求他在人工智能平台上吸引人类的广告和针对人工智能机器人本身的广告中看到的机会。

Gravity 独家向 CMO Insider 透露，该公司筹集了 3050 万美元的 A 轮融资，由 Lightspeed Venture Partners 和 Commied Capital 共同领投。 这使得该初创公司的总资金达到 3850 万美元。

Gravity 提供了一个全栈广告平台：一个帮助广告商在人工智能聊天机器人和代理中投放广告的需求方平台，一个帮助人工智能应用程序开发人员通过广告获利的供应方平台，以及一个连接两者的交换平台。 它还提供工具来帮助广告商衡量活动效果并自行制作广告。

该初创公司在人工智能聊天机器人和助手中放置基于文本的广告，包括 ChatGPT、Codebuff、EcoGPT、Daimon、Magneta、Runable 和 CTO.new。 其广告客户包括 Best Buy、Target、Vercel 和 MongoDB。

Gravity 还在测试人类用户看不到的“代理对代理”广告产品。 广告商向 Gravity 提供其产品目录，包括最新功能和当前促销活动。

“每次代理商寻找鞋子时，都会给出一份我们销售鞋子的所有不同广告商的清单，”奥尔德姆说。 “它有关于它们的详细描述和信息，这有助于丰富购买决策。”

未来，Gravity 计划整合直接支付解决方案，以便代理商在用户同意后即可进行购买。

奥尔德姆表示，他希望大型语言模型中广告的普及能够鼓励更多人工智能平台免费提供服务。

广告巨头 WPP Media 最近估计，到 2030 年，营销人员将在全球生成式人工智能搜索广告上花费 1000 亿美元。 4 月份，The Information 报道称，OpenAI 预测，到 2030 年，仅广告业务就将达到 1000 亿美元的里程碑。

“我认为就连 OpenAI 也没有达到他们的预期，”奥尔德姆说。

“它比他们意识到的要大得多，”他补充道，指的是人工智能广告市场的潜在规模。

Gravity只是大市场中的一个小角色。 谷歌经营着全球最大的广告业务。 OpenAI 已经与多个广告技术合作伙伴签约，包括 Adob​​e、StackAdapt 和 Criteo。 许多其他大型广告技术公司也希望进入这个新兴领域。

Oldham 表示，Gravity 的竞争优势在于它专注于人工智能原生广告领域，并且与这种新兴广告类型的买家和卖家都有合作。

“因为我们拥有完整的堆栈，所以随着规模的扩大，我们受益于真正的网络效应，”奥尔德姆说。 “我们的网络每天都变得更加智能。”
